findings.title: Outdated OpenSSH version
findings.description: The SSH banner advertises an OpenSSH release with several fixed advisories.
findings.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to the latest stable release and restart the service.

findings.title: Publicly exposed object storage bucket
findings.description: The storage bucket allows anonymous list and read access.
findings.remediation: Restrict bucket policy to authenticated principals and enable access logging.

findings.title: Container image built from an unpinned base image tag
findings.description: The build uses "python:latest" instead of a pinned digest.
findings.remediation: Pin the base image to a specific digest and update it deliberately.
